intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in the Pune region of Maharashtra. This page compares recorded fees, placements and NIRF ranks from our database and official ranking pages opened in {{year}}.

COEP Pune vs Pimpri Chinchwad College of Engineering is a government technological university campus compared with a well-known Pune private college. COEP has the higher NIRF 2025 Engineering rank, at 90, against PCCOE's older 2021 rank of 251.

sections.heading: COEP Pune vs Pimpri Chinchwad College of Engineering for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose COEP if you want the government Pune campus and the higher NIRF 2025 Engineering rank, at 90. Admission is through MHT-CET.

Choose PCCOE if you want a 2023 placement record on this page, with an average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh. COEP's latest recorded year here is 2020, and the average in that row is not usable.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Our records list a year-wise total of ₹1.42 lakh for COEP. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed four-year total, and confirm COEP's official circular for your Maharashtra quota.

PCCOE has recorded tuition of ₹76,818 a year, plus smaller admission, development, student and university fee rows. Those smaller heads, including ₹790 and ₹1,000 rows, are not the programme tuition. The tuition figure is the one to compare, after you check the official notice.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: PCCOE's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹3 lakh and a highest package of ₹8 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
COEP's recorded 2020 row shows a highest package of ₹39 lakh, but the average is recorded as zero, so we do not quote a COEP average. Ask COEP for its latest official placement report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: COEP lists Maharashtra CET on this page. PCCOE lists JEE Main and Maharashtra CET. Most state seats at both colleges go through MHT-CET counselling.
Read the current MHT-CET and CAP information brochure for eligibility, categories and counselling rounds.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: COEP is in central Pune, at Shivajinagar. PCCOE is in Pimpri-Chinchwad, in the wider Pune metropolitan area.
If you already plan to study in Pune, visit both campuses. The commute between Shivajinagar and Pimpri-Chinchwad is part of the decision.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If NIRF 2025 Engineering rank and a government Pune campus matter most, COEP at rank 90 is the stronger official name.
If you want a recorded 2023 average and highest package on this page, PCCOE is the side with complete 2023 figures, though they are modest.
Do not use PCCOE's small fee heads or COEP's zero average as decision numbers. Confirm both official fee and placement notices.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, COEP Pune or PCCOE, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: COEP has the higher NIRF 2025 Engineering rank, at 90, against PCCOE's 2021 rank of 251. PCCOE has the complete 2023 placement record on this page. COEP's 2020 highest package is ₹39 lakh, but its average is not usable in our records.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for COEP vs PCCOE?
faqs.answer: Our records list a year-wise total of ₹1.42 lakh for COEP and tuition of ₹76,818 a year for PCCOE. Smaller PCCOE admission and university-fee rows are not the programme tuition. Confirm official circulars for your quota.

faqs.question: Which exams do COEP and PCCOE accept?
faqs.answer: COEP lists Maharashtra CET. PCCOE lists JEE Main and Maharashtra CET. Most state seats at both colleges go through MHT-CET counselling.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for COEP and PCCOE?
faqs.answer: PCCOE's recorded 2023 average is ₹3 lakh and the highest is ₹8 lakh. COEP's recorded 2020 highest is ₹39 lakh, but the average in that row is not usable. Ask COEP for its latest official report.

faqs.question: Are COEP and PCCOE in the same part of Pune?
faqs.answer: Both are in the Pune region, on different campuses. COEP is at Shivajinagar. PCCOE is in Pimpri-Chinchwad.
